stories.headline: Macron launches four-day Africa tour culminating in Kenya's 'Africa Forward' summit
stories.summary: President Macron traveled to Alexandria (Egypt), Nairobi (Kenya), and Addis Ababa (Ethiopia) from May 9-12, co-hosting the 'Africa Forward' summit with Kenyan President William Ruto — the first France-Africa summit held in an Anglophone country. Macron declared the era of the French 'pré carré' in Africa 'over' and sought to recast France's role on the continent around economic partnership and investment after expulsions from West Africa.

stories.headline: France deploys Charles de Gaulle carrier toward Hormuz; Iran threatens immediate response as Macron clarifies mission
stories.summary: France moved its aircraft carrier strike group (Charles de Gaulle) through the Suez Canal into the Red Sea on May 6 in preparation for a potential Franco-British coalition mission to secure the Strait of Hormuz. Iran threatened an 'immediate response' to any deployment; Macron, speaking from Kenya, clarified France had never envisioned a unilateral 'deployment' but rather a multilateral security mission coordinated with Iran.

stories.headline: France-Algeria diplomatic thaw: ambassador returns to Algiers as France commemorates Sétif massacres
stories.summary: France announced on May 8 that its ambassador Stéphane Romatet — recalled to Paris in April 2025 after a diplomatic rupture — would resume activities in Algeria. The move coincided with the commemoration of the May 8, 1945 Sétif massacres; junior defense minister Alice Rufo traveled to Algeria at Macron's request, and was received by President Tebboune and army chief Chanegriha. The release of French journalist Christophe Gleizes remains a stated priority.

stories.headline: European public prosecutor opens fraud investigation into RN over Bardella media training funded by EU money
stories.summary: The European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) opened an investigation into the Rassemblement National over allegations that over €130,000 in European Parliament funds were used to train Jordan Bardella in media skills ahead of Marine Le Pen's 2022 presidential campaign — rather than for European parliamentary work. Marine Le Pen denounced the probe as a 'maneuver' to 'tarnish' Bardella; the RN contested the accusations.

stories.headline: Mélenchon announces fourth presidential candidacy, unveils NATO exit and China-Taiwan positions
stories.summary: Jean-Luc Mélenchon officially declared his fourth presidential candidacy on May 3 on TF1's evening news, then gave a lengthy LCI interview on May 8 in which he called for France to leave NATO 'by stages,' said Taiwan 'is China,' and called on left parties to avoid 'anti-LFI suicide.' Polls show 70% of French voters see his candidacy as a handicap for the left; other left parties have largely refused to rally behind him.

stories.headline: 2027 presidential race: RN leads all polls as opposition fragments and Attal-Philippe signal contingency pact
stories.summary: Multiple polls published this week confirm the RN leading first-round intentions by a wide margin (Bardella at ~34-35%, Philippe at ~19%); Gabriel Attal revealed an informal understanding with Édouard Philippe that the less-well-positioned of the two would withdraw if a RN vs. LFI second round appeared likely. About 30 declared candidates are now in the race, while the RN continued struggling to secure campaign bank loans.
